topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I opened the door to find a small parcel, wrapped neatly and addressed to someone I didn’t know. It must have been for the previous tenant. As I held it, wondering what to do, I thought about how easy it would be to simply set it aside. But something felt important about this package, a piece of someone’s life that had mistakenly found its way to me. I decided to take a moment to sit and think about how best to return it. Perhaps I could find the real recipient by asking around or posting a note in the community board. It’s a small act, but I hope it can make a difference in someone’s day. After all, a little kindness can go a long way, and who knows how much this package might mean to its rightful owner.
